changes: Converted from the official PDF to Markdown by the your5e/5e-srd-markdown project, then to HTML and JSON, reformatted and indexed for mistLAB. That Markdown conversion dropped most table titles and reworded the sentences that named them (for example “as shown on the Travel Pace table. The table states” became “The table states”); mistLAB restored the table titles from the official PDF, but not those sentences. mistLAB also rejoined words split by the PDF extraction and set the Efreeti Bottle table’s die back to 1d10 as printed. Otherwise no rules text was changed.
